plot: The day after the duck jam, Turbo and Bolt both try out for the school crossing-guard job with retired guard Mrs. Maple at sunset; Turbo rushes his stop and rushes Pip across, Bolt is careful but bores Pip with rules, and during the break Bolt rehearses his thank-you speech while a thump at the crossing goes unnoticed; when the sun touches the hill Maple gives the badge to Turbo, because the break was the real test and he quietly came back, stopped the cars and picked up Pip's spilled books; Bolt is proud of him; lesson: kindness counts most when nobody is watching; then Maple says a storm comes tonight and Turbo has never driven slowly in rain.

script.title: Who Gets the Crossing Guard Job?

set.place: Wheelburg school crossing by the park, crossing-guard try-out after school at sunset

script.description: Turbo and Bolt both want to be the new crossing guard. Inspector Bolt #14

beats.say: Out of my way! Wheelburg's new crossing guard is coming through!
Not so fast, Turbo. I am trying for that job too.
It was the next day after school, by the park crossing.
Yesterday Bolt saved the ducks. Today, two friends wanted the same job.
Good afternoon, everyone. My name is Mrs. Maple.
For thirty years, I kept this crossing safe for every kid.
Now I need someone new. One badge. Two cars.
Easy! I'm the fastest car in town. Fast is good, right?
Hmm. We will see, dear. And remember one thing.
I am always watching. Even when you think the test is over.
Ooh! I brought the whole school to cheer for you!
Go, Turbo! Go, Bolt! Go, both of you!
I brought cones. Nobody cheers for cones. Hmph.

beats.text: TEST ONE: STOP AT THE LINE

beats.say: When I blow my whistle, stop right at the cones.
Not one inch past. Little wheels may be crossing.
Phweeet!
Turbo zoomed toward the cones like a rocket.
Brakes, brakes, brakes! Whoaaa!
He stopped. Exactly at the cones. With his roof a little squished.
Ta-da! Perfect stop! My roof is fine. Mostly.
Then Bolt rolled up. Slowly. Calmly. And stopped right on the line.
Procedure. Look left. Look right. Stop.
Both cones still standing. That's a first for Turbo.
Two good stops. One fast, one careful. Interesting.

beats.text: TEST TWO: HELP A KID CROSS

beats.say: I'll be the kid! I even have my real school backpack!
Lovely. Turbo, please help Pip cross the road.
Come on, Pip! Go, go, go! Faster! Speed is fun!
Turbo! My backpack is heavy! I can't go that fast!
Pip wobbled across the road, huffing and puffing.
Oh dear. Crossing is not a race, Turbo.
Right. Sorry, Pip. I always forget that one.
Inspector Bolt. Your turn.
Pip, before we cross, we must learn the rules.
There are seven rules of the road. Let us begin.
Rule one. Rule two. Rule three, and that's very important...
Bolt... my wheels are falling asleep.
Pip? Pip! Wake up! We haven't even reached rule four!
Ha! Too slow and too fast! This is so exciting!

beats.text: WHEN THE SUN TOUCHES THE HILL...

beats.say: When the sun touches that hill, I will choose.
Until then, everybody, take a short break.
Turbo rolled away and parked next to Grumpy. He was very quiet.
You're quiet. That's not like you. It's scary.
Everyone says I'm only good at being fast.
I wanted to be good at something else. Just once.
Hmph. You're good at more than you think, kid.
Meanwhile, Bolt practised his speech for Mrs. Maple.
Mrs. Maple, thank you so much for this shiny badge.
I promise to be careful, calm, and correct. Every day.
Ooh, that's lovely, Bolt! Say it again, with feeling!
Careful. Calm. Correct. And very, very punctual.
Behind them, at the crossing, something fell with a loud thump.
Did you hear that?
Hmm? No. Let me practise one more time.
Bolt practised. Bertha clapped. And nobody looked back at the crossing.

beats.text: THE SUN IS TOUCHING THE HILL!

beats.say: Time is up. Everybody, gather round. I have chosen.
This is it! I can't look! Somebody tell me when it's over!
May the most careful car win.
Yeah. It's Bolt. We all know it's Bolt.
The badge goes to... Turbo.
Me? But I zoomed! I squished my roof! I rushed Pip!
Mrs. Maple, with respect. How?
The break was the real test. I told you I'm always watching.
Pip's backpack fell open on the road. Books everywhere.
And Turbo came back! He turned on his blinking lights!
Every car stopped and waited. Nobody drove over my books.
Then he picked up every book. Even the one with my drawings.
Turbo! Why didn't you tell anyone?
It wasn't for a prize. Pip needed help. So I helped.
Told you, kid. More than you think.
Bolt was quiet for a moment. Then he rolled up to Turbo.
I was so busy with my speech, I never even looked.
You earned it, Turbo. I'm proud of you. Really.
A crossing guard watches the road, not the badge.
Being kind counts most when nobody is watching!
I'm the crossing guard! Fast at helping! Slow at crossing!
Everyone honked and cheered. Even Grumpy's cones looked happy.
Losing to a good friend still feels a lot like winning.
Your first shift is tomorrow at seven. Oh, and one more thing.
A big storm is coming tonight. Rain, wind, and puddles.
Rain? Puddles? I have never driven slowly in the rain...
